testsuite.name: personal withdrawal and model deletion use real transactions and durable provider results

testcase.name: only the subject sees model targets; organization and operator cannot act as the subject
scope, version, consent ownership and explicit withdrawal are required
action-record failure rolls back consent, audit, request and outbox together
withdrawal retries are idempotent and authorization is actually unusable
deletion and privacy action are atomic; failed recording creates no external job
same deletion is queued once; order need not be paid to exercise withdrawal
missing provider configuration leaves a visible failure and never calls upstream
changed provider account cannot receive a deletion for the former account
accepted task and an unconfirmed deletion receipt do not mean deleted
verified receipt completes only that model and retry recovers without resubmitting
tampered result cannot be exposed as successful deletion
personal creation list shows only own training tasks and paginates without exposing provider details
waiting and blocked creation remain distinct from a registered or deleted model
a subject can discover consent before any model exists and withdraw through the existing action
registered late result keeps the model deletion state and never closes the personal request
wrong task binding or foreign model cannot be exposed as a personal result

testsuite.name: personal copy provides bounded records and actual private bytes without claiming complete fulfilment

testcase.name: seven categories are explicit; no automatic copy request completion
new and legacy authorizations paginate without leaking other people or review internals
same ID in two record domains is grouped, not lost between pages
model record belongs to consent subject, not to uploader or producer
stored authorization corruption cannot become a trusted copy
material metadata includes recorded creation and only the applicants own artist link
actual file bytes match recorded hash; wrong person, purpose and request scope rejected
erased file retains only metadata and cannot be downloaded as a usable original
withdrawn access during storage read cannot send bytes to the client

testsuite.name: privacy restrictions protect commercial and release evidence across their original download routes

testcase.name: commercial-evidence becomes unreadable after independently approved restriction and restores only after release
commercial-evidence restriction appearing during storage transport blocks returning stale bytes
commercial-evidence releasing one of two independent restrictions cannot restore content
commercial-evidence losing operator access during storage transport cannot return content
release-channel-evidence becomes unreadable after independently approved restriction and restores only after release
release-channel-evidence restriction appearing during storage transport blocks returning stale bytes
release-channel-evidence releasing one of two independent restrictions cannot restore content
release-channel-evidence losing operator access during storage transport cannot return content
approved raw-material erasure rechecks a new live avatar reference and keeps stored bytes
personal original copy cannot bypass restrictions or grant handlers raw evidence access
revoked handling permission cannot execute an approved restriction

testsuite.name: reviewed privacy execution changes actual records and preserves unresolved boundaries

testcase.name: copy only returns own explicitly requested profile and cannot enumerate another account
personal copy includes own stories and buyer order index without exposing another person or contract body
paid history allows only proven completed buyer work and rejects incomplete work or pending refund
correction requires independent approval and actually updates profile
deletion lists readable own materials and reviewed policies; referenced files require review
missing effective policy cannot authorize deletion
file removal is bound to owner and exact storage configuration
unknown deletion result remains pending; retry checks same object and records current-object-only result
complaint restricts actual download and approved release restores only that restriction
closing sole organization owner is blocked and leaves login intact
account closure revokes old sessions and personal identity while retaining request evidence
lost closure response keeps sessions closed and operators can reconcile the single executed request
new closure clock requires verified identity and actual execution before completion
stock buyer must accept delivery and resolve aftercare; merchant obligations are never inferred complete
HTTP exposes the same scoped proposal, review, execution and export flow
restoring an actual older backup requires replaying latest erasure register before access

testsuite.name: privacy responses require the actual reviewed files before publication

testcase.name: a READY metadata row without stored bytes cannot be offered as a delivered copy
missing bytes at independent review do not publish; same request recovers after restoration
tampered bytes cannot pass even when metadata still looks ready
replacing both metadata and bytes cannot reuse the previously submitted digest
restricted evidence is blocked both before submission and before approval
legacy pending drafts require rejection and resubmission, not silent approval
partial delivery remains follow-up; subsequent replies preserve both downloadable versions
no failed approval creates a response notification, history or successful command
clients cannot forge the server attachment snapshot or submit another operator evidence
same application exports actual scoped records, delivers reviewed bytes and reopens without losing history

testsuite.name: one material and trade copy stays recoverable and scoped through actual delivery

testcase.name: real selected rows form the same request file, without other people or provider internals
lost submission result uses original key; an unapproved file stays private
revoked operator or reviewer cannot recover an old operation or approve
missing file blocks review; restoration and lost approval recover one answer only
downloaded bytes match the reviewed snapshot and same business identifiers
account disabled during file transport cannot receive bytes; restored account can retry
reopened follow-up preserves reviewed file without claiming all personal data finished

testsuite.name: personal trade copies preserve receipts, refunds and historical contracts

testcase.name: own buyer and seller paginate; organization membership gives no personal copy
gross and refund facts remain separate; no provider secrets or false completion
redacted contract has its own checksum; source stays unchanged and unsigned
scope, account and cursor isolation apply to every request
corrupt records and inconsistent journal fail closed
unknown payment and requested refund never become received or refunded money
creation, cancellation and payment deadline are actual recorded facts, not settlement timestamps
disabled account is rechecked, reads do not complete the privacy request
